fixes.explanation: Not quite, friend. The psalmist says, “I have seen a limit to all perfection, but Your commandment is without limit.” The limit belongs to all perfection that he has seen. God's commandment is the one with no limit, and that little word “but” is what flips it. (Psalm 119:96)

False, you've got it, baker! The psalmist says, “I have seen a limit to all perfection, but Your commandment is without limit.” The limit belongs to all perfection that he has seen. God's commandment is without limit. (Psalm 119:96)
